<b>Plasmium Phial</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When used, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] injects herself with Plasmium, giving her one [[Lifeblood|Plasmium]] mask.

== Usefulness ==
When Plasmium Phial is used, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] stops all movement (including in mid-air) and injects herself with Plasmium, giving her one [[Lifeblood|Plasmium]] Mask. Plasmium functions nearly identically to [[Lifeblood]] from <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>, granting extra temporary Masks that are removed when resting at a [[Bench (Silksong)|Bench]].

When refilled at a Bench, the phials drain a reserve that holds 20 uses, as well as consuming [[Shell Shards]] to refill each phial. The reserve can be refilled by [[Alchemist Zylotol]] in the [[Wormways]] at a cost of {{R|50}}. After completing the <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> [[wish]] and obtaining the [[Plasmium Gland]], this Tool no longer needs a reserve and only requires Shell Shards to refill.

If Hornet does not have enough Shell Shards, or her Plasmium reserve runs dry, she cannot craft new phials.

* Plasmium Phial can be used for extra Masks before fighting a boss or a difficult trial. However, it can be more useful to conserve the Phials, allowing Hornet to heal early damage with [[Bind]] and use Plasmium when she starts running low on [[Silk]].
* This Tool is also helpful for retrieving a [[Cocoon]] if Hornet is at risk of dying on the way back.
* Plasmium Phial can be especially effective for long platforming challenges, such as climbing [[Mount Fay]].
* Since resting at a Bench removes Plasmium Masks, Hornet's maximum number is limited by the phials she can carry at once. However, this limitation can be circumvented by either using the [[Architect Crest]]'s Craft Bind to craft phials without a Bench, or by killing [[Winged Lifeseed]]s to gain Plasmium Masks.
* Entering a memory sequance does not remove Plasmium Masks, but exiting does.
=== Plasmification ===
If Hornet manages to gain 9 Plasmium Masks, she enters a plasmified state. This can be achieved through Craft Binding phials with the [[Architect Crest]], or from [[Plasmium Cocoon]]s in the [[Wormways]] and [[Bonegrave]]. It is not possible to become plasmified without the Plasmium Phial, as there are at most only 3 Plasmium Cocoons in Pharloom, for a total of 6 [[Winged Lifeseed]]s.

* Entering the plasmified state involves a brief animation where Hornet convulses and groans in pain. If she takes damage during this animation, <i>all</i> Plasmium Masks are lost and the Plasmification fails.
** When the animation finishes, Hornet's normal Masks visually transform into Plasmium, any Plasmium Masks above her maximum health disappear, and the Crest on the HUD tints and drips blue.
Plasmified Hornet passively recovers one Mask every 6 seconds, but the regeneration progress resets whenever she heals or takes damage. [[Bind]]ing becomes less effective, as it only heals one Mask rather than three. However, the unique Bind of the [[Witch Crest]] remains unaffected, and the unique Bind of the [[Beast Crest]] retains its normal effects while also healing one Mask immediately. Plasmium Phials and Winged Lifeseeds will restore the transformed Masks rather than adding any above Hornet's maximum Health.

* Using the [[Architect Crest]] without using a Plasmium Cocoon requires {{S|120}} in total to obtain the plasmified state.
* Dying, resting at a Bench, going through a cutscene, binding a new ability, or [[Mask Shard (Silksong)|obtaining a new Mask]] will remove the plasmified state. This can limit the usability of plasmification, given that everytime that a Bench is used or after dying, the plasmification effects needs to be activated again.
** Even so, the passive health regeneration it provides is helpful, reducing the need to heal and allowing Hornet to use her [[Silk]] more aggressively,<ref group="Note">In theory, the [[Cursed Crest]] and [[Shaman Crest]] would benefit the most from Plasmification, but they cannot due to neither having any {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} slots.</ref> and mitigating the threat of death in prolonged situations where Silk is scarce.
* Entering or exiting memories removes the plasmified state.

== How to Acquire ==
Given by [[Alchemist Zylotol]] after completing the <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> [[wish]]. Hornet can refill her reserve of Plasmium by paying Alchemist Zylotol {{R|50}}. After completing the <i>[[Advanced Alchemy]]</i> wish and obtaining the [[Plasmium Gland]], the Tool no longer needs its reserve to be refilled.

== Trivia ==
* Plasmification visually resembles the effects of [[Joni's Blessing]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight]]</i>. Functionally, it behaves similarly to [[Hiveblood]] on its own, but faster and without the restriction of only healing the last Mask that was lost.
* NPCs will startle if Hornet uses the Plasmium Phial while very close to them.
* There is a unique effect which removes Plasmification during the [[Endings (Silksong)#Ending 1: Weaver Queen|Weaver Queen]] ending sequence.
* In the <i>Silksong</i> reveal trailer, the Plasmium Phial had a slightly different sprite and granted 2 Plasmium Masks instead of 1.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c Hollow Knight: Silksong Reveal Trailer]</ref>
